description: Righteous fury - Holy damage delivered at the end of a weapon.

nodes.name: Deflection
nodes.description: Increases your parry chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0, NEW to our tree: 'Increases your Parry chance by 1%-5%.' Built verbatim. parry is PERCENTAGE POINTS, landing through a diminishing-returns curve.

nodes.name: Benediction
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your abilities by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Reduces the mana cost of all instant cast spells by 2%-10%.' There is no cast-time distinction, so it covers everything. MIND THE KEY: all_ability_cost_pct is a FRACTION where POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION, and it FLIPS to percentage POINTS inside a status effect. The outgoing version was a flat cost cut on Crusader Strike alone.

nodes.name: Improved Judgements
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Judgement by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Decreases the cooldown of your Judgement spells by 1/2 sec.' Built as cooldown, which is what the real talent does. The outgoing version increased Judgement DAMAGE instead, which is The Art of War's job.

nodes.name: Vindication
nodes.description: Your strikes have a 50% chance per rank to weaken the target's attack power for 3 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Gives the Paladin's damaging attacks a chance to reduce the target's attack power by 23/46 for 10 sec.' Built with the real -46 and the real 10 seconds (3 turns). attack_power on a monster or inside a status effect is FLAT, and it is one of the eight stat_mods a MONSTER can actually read - which matters, because a debuff the enemy cannot read does nothing. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Heart of the Crusader
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'your Judgement spells will also increase the critical strike chance of all attacks made against that target by an additional 1%-3%.' DEPARTURE - there is no 'crit chance against this target' debuff; crit is resolved from the attacker's own stats, and the only target-side crit key is crit_taken_reduction, which only reduces. Delivered as the paladin's own crit. Kept from the outgoing tree, corrected from 1.5 to the real 1% per rank.

nodes.name: Conviction
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 1%-5%.' Built verbatim and kept from the outgoing tree. It is Vengeance's prerequisite in the real tree, preserved below.

nodes.name: Improved Blessing of Might
nodes.description: Increases the attack power your Blessing of Might grants by 12% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases the attack power bonus of your Blessing of Might by 12%/25%.' Built verbatim over the real 2 ranks; the outgoing version had 5 ranks of 8%, reaching 40%. ability_<id>_potency scales the ability's own stat_mods.

nodes.name: Seal of Command
nodes.description: Teaches Seal of Command, adding Holy damage to every strike.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, kept - the ONLY unlock for paladin_seal_of_command, which is requires_talent.

nodes.name: Pursuit of Justice
nodes.description: Increases your chance to hit by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Reduces the duration of all Disarm effects by 25%/50% and increases movement and mounted movement speed by 8%/15%.' DEPARTURE - no movement speed and no Disarm duration modifier. Delivered as accuracy, the nearest offensive equivalent of closing on a target. Kept from the outgoing tree, corrected from 1.5 to 1 per rank.

nodes.name: Eye for an Eye
nodes.description: Being struck has a 50% chance per rank to lash back at your attacker.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'All criticals against you cause 10%/20% of the damage taken to the attacker as well.' DEPARTURE on the trigger - there is no on-crit-TAKEN event, only on_damage_taken, so icd 1 holds it to once a turn. Percentage-of-damage-taken reflection is also unavailable: of the three payloads that read the triggering amount (bonus_pct, leech_pct, smart heals), none reflects, so damage_flat 30 is a fixed return typed as Holy. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
nodes.description: Increases your physical damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 2%/4%/6%.' Built minus the weapon gate. The outgoing version was attack_power_pct, which is a different stat. physical_damage is a FRACTION.

nodes.name: Sanctity of Battle
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1% per rank and the damage of your Exorcism and Crusader Strike by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, built verbatim with both halves: 'Increases your chance to critically hit with all spells and attacks by 1%-3% and increases the damage caused by Exorcism and Crusader Strike by 5%/10%/15%.' The outgoing version had the damage half on Consecration rather than Exorcism and omitted the crit.

nodes.name: Sanctified Retribution
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 3%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Increases the damage caused by Retribution Aura by 50% and all damage caused by friendly targets affected by any of your Auras is increased by 3%.' DEPARTURE - there is no aura system and a talent effect can never reach an ally, so the real 3% applies to the paladin alone. The outgoing version was a proc.

nodes.name: Crusade
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Increases all damage caused by 1%-3% and all damage caused against Humanoids, Demons, Undead and Elementals by an additional 1%-3%.' The unconditional half is built verbatim. The creature-type half cannot be built - NOTHING in this engine reads a creature type. The outgoing version was physical_damage, which excludes the paladin's Holy damage and so missed most of the point.

nodes.name: Vengeance
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 33% chance per rank to increase your damage by 3% for 4 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3: 'Gives you a 1%-3% bonus to Physical and Holy damage you deal for 30 sec after dealing a critical strike from a weapon swing, spell, or ability. This effect stacks up to 3 times.' Built with the real 3% at full effect and 30 seconds as 4 turns. STACKING IS DROPPED: max_stacks exists on StatusEffect but NOTHING in this engine reads a stack count, so a 3-stack version would be indistinguishable from a 1-stack one. Ranked by chance, since a proc's payload does not scale with points. The real talent requires Conviction, reproduced. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Divine Purpose
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of Stun effects against you by 15% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3: 'Reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by 2%/4% and gives your Hand of Freedom spell a 100% chance to remove any Stun effects on the target.' DEPARTURE - no caster-side miss chance for INCOMING attacks (hit_chance_spell is a dead talent key set once in Character.__init__) and no Hand of Freedom. The stun clause survives, applied to the paladin. Kept from the outgoing tree, corrected from 3 ranks to the real 2.

nodes.name: The Art of War
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Judgement, Crusader Strike and Divine Storm by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree: 'Increases the damage of your Judgement, Crusader Strike and Divine Storm abilities by 5%/10% and when your melee attacks critically hit your next Flash of Light or Exorcism is instant.' The damage half is built verbatim across all three real abilities. The instant-cast half has nothing to act on - there are no cast times.

nodes.name: Repentance
nodes.description: Teaches Repentance, holding an enemy in meditation.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, kept - the ONLY unlock for paladin_repentance, which is requires_talent. It is Fanaticism's prerequisite in the real tree, preserved below.

nodes.name: Fanaticism
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Judgement by 6% per rank and reduces your threat by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, built verbatim with both halves: 'Increases the critical strike chance of all Judgements capable of a critical hit by 6%-18% and reduces threat caused by all actions by 10%-30%.' ability_<id>_crit is PERCENTAGE POINTS and threat_generation_pct is a FRACTION. The outgoing version was crit on Crusader Strike with no threat clause. The real talent requires Repentance, reproduced.

nodes.name: Judgements of the Wise
nodes.description: Your Judgement restores 200 mana.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree: 'Your damaging Judgement spells have a 33%-100% chance to grant the Replenishment effect to up to 10 party or raid members, granting mana regeneration equal to 1% of their maximum mana per 10 sec.' DEPARTURE - a talent effect can never reach an ally, so the mana goes to the paladin. The real chance curve is kept exactly. grant_resource takes a FLAT amount with no pct_max, so 200 is a fixed return rather than a percentage of the pool.

nodes.name: Sanctified Wrath
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Hammer of Wrath by 25% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Hammer of Wrath by 25%/50%, reduces the cooldown of Avenging Wrath by 30/60 secs and while affected by Avenging Wrath 25%/50% of all damage is converted to healing.' Only the Hammer of Wrath clause is buildable - Avenging Wrath does not exist and there is no damage-to-healing conversion. Built at the real 25% per rank.

nodes.name: Swift Retribution
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Your auras also increase casting, ranged and melee attack speeds by 1%-3%.' DEPARTURE - no aura system and a talent effect cannot reach an ally, so the real 3% applies to the paladin. haste is PERCENTAGE POINTS. The outgoing version was a proc.

nodes.name: Righteous Vengeance
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 33% chance per rank to leave the target burning for 3 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'When your Judgement, Crusader Strike and Divine Storm spells deal a critical strike, your target will take 10%-30% additional damage over 8 sec.' Built as a real Holy dot. Percentage-of-damage scaling is not available to a proc payload - potency is a FLAT PER-TURN number, where an ABILITY rank's effect_value is the TOTAL and gets divided - so 45 a turn over 3 turns (8 seconds) is a fixed bleed. The ability_filter is omitted deliberately: on_crit already requires a crit, and restricting to the three abilities would exclude the weapon-swing crits the tree's other talents are built to produce. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Sheath of Light
nodes.description: Increases your spell power by 10% of your attack power per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Increases your spell power by an amount equal to 10%-30% of your attack power and your critical healing spells heal the target for 60% of the healed amount over 12 seconds.' The conversion half is a REAL pairing - spell_power is a valid STAT_CONVERSION_TARGET and ap a valid source - built at 0.10 per rank to reach the real 30%. THE UNIT IS A RAW MULTIPLIER, not a percentage (character.py:1551 does `gained = source * pct`). The critical-heal-hot clause has no key. The outgoing version was attack_power_pct plus Flash of Light healing, neither of which is this talent.

nodes.name: Divine Storm
nodes.description: Teaches Divine Storm, a whirling strike that mends your allies as it wounds your enemies.
nodes._source: WotLK row 10, the capstone, kept - the ONLY unlock for paladin_divine_storm, which is requires_talent.
